# Where Kotoshironushi works now: the myths behind the markets

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Kotoshironushi** works now.

Kotoshironushi's mythology centers on the peaceful transfer of sovereignty from the earthly kami to the heavenly line.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Kotoshironushi
- **Pantheon:** Japanese
- **Domain of influence:** Oracles, Fishing
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 261 of 542

## The Myth at Work

**The Cession of the Land.** When Amaterasu sent her grandson Ninigi to rule the earth, the earthly kami Ōkuninushi resisted.  After negotiations and divine pressure, Ōkuninushi asked his son Kotoshironushi for advice. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**Oracle at Miwa.** The Nihon Shoki associates Kotoshironushi with the Miwa area and with oracular divination.  His withdrawal to the sea and identification with marine fortune reflect his role as a mediator between land and water, old order and new. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries

*Shipping, ports, fishing, and ocean exploration. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The oracular kami of fishing who yields the sea's knowledge along with its catch.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Kotoshironushi performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The oracular kami enshrined at Izumo and beyond; divination and sacred proxy are acts of faith.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The kami of oracles and hidden knowledge; divination is his original craft.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

## The Long Employment

Kotoshironushi is rarely worshipped independently today, but his legacy lives in Ebisu and in the story of how the imperial line gained the land without total war.  He is remembered as the son who advised surrender for the greater good. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity’s documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in maritime, shipping & ocean industries, faith & spiritual organizations, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/kotoshironushi/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
